trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE ((CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) <> 0 AND p.name = 'Erick Strickland') OR (p.birth_date <> '1973/11/25' AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0)) RETURN DISTINCT p.nationality AS col1, p.olympic_gold_medals AS col2, p.fiba_world_cup AS col3, p.name AS name_player
